body:
My understanding having just been looking into this code due to my own issue is the engine supports 16 instance uniforms per instance and will use up this many slots in the buffer regardless of how many you are actually using, probably to avoid fragmentation in the buffer. 50 labels will therefore be using up 800 slots in the 1024 buffer. If anything else in the scene is using the buffer that will quickly push you over.

Not sure what option you have other than manually recompiling the engine with a lower value of MAX_INSTANCE_UNIFORM_INDICES, assuming you don't need that many per label.

Also keep in mind this applies to all objects using instance uniforms, including those that are invisible or outside the field of view, etc. And once it fails on an instance, that instance will remain broken even if you drop below the limit.
